comment: Hand computed golden invoices. Every expected number below was worked out by hand from the committed dataset before running the engine. Rates are basis points; money is integer cents. Stack order is state, county, city, then special districts sorted by id.

cases.name: g01_basic_stack_origin_state
cases.notes: CD is origin sourced, intrastate sale, so situs is ship_from CI-CD-00-0. Rates on 2023-01-15: ST-CD 573, CO-CD-00 165, CI-CD-00-0 41, SP-CD-00 22, SP-CD-15 42. Gross 10000. 10000*573/10000=573 exact, likewise 165, 41, 22, 42. Tax 843.

cases.name: g02_same_invoice_after_rate_change
cases.notes: Same invoice as g01 dated 2024-06-15. SP-CD-00 changed from 22 to 97 bps effective 2024-04-01, everything else unchanged. 10000*97/10000=97. Tax 573+165+41+97+42=918.

cases.name: g03_clothing_threshold_boundary_MW
cases.notes: Interstate sale sources to destination CI-MW-00-0. MW exempts clothing under 11000 cents per item. Line 1 at 10999 is exempt. Line 2 at 11000 is fully taxable. Rates on 2023-01-15: ST-MW 693, CO-MW-00 62, CI-MW-00-0 33, SP-MW-01 53. 11000*693/10000=762.3 rounds to 762 (half_up), 68.2 to 68, 36.3 to 36 (half_even), 58.3 to 58 (half_even). Tax 924.

cases.name: g04_half_up_tie_and_half_down_state_JN
cases.notes: Destination CI-JN-00-0 on 2023-06-01: ST-JN 521 (half_down), CO-JN-00 33 (half_up), CI-JN-00-0 50 (half_up). Gross 2500. 2500*521/10000=130.25 rounds down to 130, 8.25 to 8, and 12.5 is an exact tie under half_up so 13. Tax 151.

cases.name: g05_half_down_tie_city_CD
cases.notes: Origin sourced intrastate CD sale from CI-CD-00-1, situs CI-CD-00-1. On 2023-08-01: ST-CD 573, CO-CD-00 165, CI-CD-00-1 164 (half_down, effective 2023-07-01). Gross 1250. 71.625 rounds to 72, 20.625 to 21, and 1250*164/10000=20.5 is an exact tie under half_down so 20. Tax 113.

cases.name: g06_grocery_exemption_mixed_invoice
cases.notes: Interstate to CI-CD-00-0 (destination because interstate). CD exempts groceries; prepared_food is taxable. Taxable gross 5000*2=10000 gives the same 843 stack as g01.

cases.name: g08_nonprofit_certificate_full_exemption
cases.notes: CERT-001 is a nonprofit certificate covering all categories, valid 2021-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Electronics line is exempted by the certificate; groceries line is exempt by the matrix anyway. Tax 0.

cases.name: g09_expired_certificate_charges_tax
cases.notes: CERT-000 (resale, covers electronics) expired 2024-12-31, invoice dated 2025-03-01, so tax is charged. Origin sourced situs CI-CD-00-0. SP-CD-00 is 47 bps from 2025-01-01. Tax 573+165+41+47+42=868.

cases.name: g10_use_tax_accrual_at_destination
cases.notes: Use tax always accrues at destination CI-MW-00-0 even though ship_from state CD is origin sourced. Gross 50000 on 2023-01-15: 3465 exact, 310, 165, 265. Tax 4205, flagged as accrual.

cases.name: g11_HC_threshold_with_time_travel_rates
cases.notes: Destination CI-HC-00-0 on 2024-02-01: ST-HC 437 (dropped from 487 on 2024-01-01), CO-HC-00 29, CI-HC-00-0 25 (in effect 2023-10-01 to 2024-04-01). HC exempts clothing under 17500. Line 1 at 17499 exempt. Line 2: 17500*2=35000 gross, 35000*437/10000=1529.5 tie half_up 1530, 101.5 to 102, 87.5 to 88. Tax 1720.

cases.name: g12_JN_clothing_fully_exempt
cases.notes: JN exempts clothing entirely. Books line reuses the g04 stack: 130, 8, 13 for gross 2500. Tax 151.
